description: This source file defines the enum GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport with static methods for managing gateway selection logic, including applying remote selection, choosing preferred transport, and determining whether to prefer direct transport based on gateway properties.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Updates the app state with the preferred transport, remote URL, target, and config for a discovered gateway.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Returns the preferred transport type for a given gateway based on whether direct transport is favored.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Determines whether to prefer direct transport for a gateway based on its URL patterns and hostname suffix.
